car: the tenth-scale autonomous race car: a tenth-scale, four-wheel-drive touring-class car with an autonomy deck
frames: every file of parts/ is in millimetres. A loose unit's file shows the unit in the attitude its `delivered` text names, which is the attitude in which it is presented in the cell: its lowest point on z = 0, its footprint's smallest enclosing rectangle centred on the origin with its long side along x (the wheel: its axis on the z axis). roller.stl is in the car's own frame: origin on the ground plane under the middle of the rear axle, x forward, y to the left, z up, the wheel hubs at the angle of the drawn model. com_mm = the centre of mass in the file's frame; size_mm = the file's bounding box
geometry: the files show the car as it is drawn (its visible surface, simplified in triangle count only). The cell's collision shapes differ from them: cell/cell_manual.md, Collision model
appearance: materials = the car model's materials by material key, appearance only: metallic and roughness (the terms the cell's cameras render them with) and the base colour rgba (a MuJoCo material's rgba, as the model has it); for the model's printed faces (the materials with a `texture`) also the image and a textured mesh (`texture_mesh`: the same triangles as that material's run in the part file, with texture coordinates, OpenGL convention, in the part file's frame and millimetres). part_materials = the material key of every triangle of each part file: runs [first triangle, number of triangles, material key] in the file's triangle order, together covering the file; the part files themselves carry no materials. A twin of the car whose part meshes are split into these runs, each with a material named mat_vis_<key> of that rgba (a textured key: its textured mesh, with the image as the colour map), renders the car as the cell's cameras render it through the given render session (arm.assembly_car.agent_render), which gives materials named mat_vis_<key> this table's metallic and roughness: cell/cell_api.md, Rendering your own frames
mass: mass_g = the mass the cell simulates for the unit, rounded to 1 g. The roller's mass_g and com_mm are those of its four wheel hubs, the only parts of it that move: the rest of the rolling chassis is clamped rigidly on the work stand and its mass plays no role in the cell
identical_units: units with the same id are interchangeable: any wheel fits any hub
not_in_the_kit: the wheel nuts and the battery hold-down bar with its two pins are fitted at another station; the photographs of the finished car show them

units.name: wheel and tyre, pre-mounted
units.role: a wheel: the rim with its tyre; it goes on a wheel hub
units.material: rubber tyre on a moulded plastic rim
units.delivered: lying on its inner face, the spoked outer face up
units.presentation: loose on the bench, lying on its inner face with the spoked outer face up, at any turn about the vertical

units.name: NiMH stick pack
units.role: the car's battery: a six-cell NiMH stick pack with its lead and plug; it lies in the battery bay of the chassis
units.material: cells in two sticks under a heat-shrink sleeve; a two-wire lead with a plug
units.delivered: lying flat on its underside, its long axis along x
units.presentation: loose on the bench, lying flat on its underside; its lead end points one way or the opposite way

units.name: deck assembly
units.role: the deck plate with what is already mounted on it: the antenna mount with the left and the right Wi-Fi antenna, the motor controller on its spacer block and the power distribution board; it sits on the four deck standoffs of the chassis and carries the compute module and the LiDAR
units.material: polymer plate; metal standoffs; two circuit boards; a wood-grain spacer block; a printed antenna mount with two plastic antennas
units.delivered: plate level, top face up, its long side along x; z = 0 at its lowest points, the screw ends under the plate
units.presentation: on the deck shelf, top face up, the same way round as on the car, its right long edge overhanging. Its part file's lowest points are screw ends under the plate; it does not rest on them

units.name: compute module
units.role: the car's compute module on its eight standoffs; it stands on the deck plate
units.material: circuit boards with a finned metal heat sink and a fan; eight metal standoffs
units.delivered: upright, as it stands on the deck plate; z = 0 at its lowest points, the screw ends under its standoffs
units.presentation: in its nest of the parts tray, standing on its standoffs, in a storage orientation that is not the mounting orientation

units.name: 2D scanning LiDAR
units.role: the car's 2D scanning LiDAR; it stands on the deck plate and has no fasteners of its own
units.material: plastic housing: a square base, a round head and a connector block on one side
units.presentation: in its nest of the parts tray, standing on its base, in a storage orientation that is not the mounting orientation

roller.name: rolling chassis
roller.role: the rolling chassis: the chassis tub with drivetrain, suspension, steering, body posts with the rear wing frame, chassis brace, motor, kit speed controller, radio receiver and steering servo, the two battery hold-down posts, the four deck standoffs and the four wheel hubs. It is clamped on the work stand and is not a loose unit
roller.material: moulded plastic chassis parts; metal shafts, standoffs and fasteners
roller.delivered: in the car's own frame, standing on the ground plane of its wheels; the hubs at the drawn model's angle
roller.presentation: clamped on the work stand by the tub's flat underside, level, its front towards the robot arm; every hub at its own random angle
